metadata.overview: Controls and monitors MicroBT Whatsminer Bitcoin miners. Operations affect physical hardware. Always prioritize thermal safety and verify telemetry changes after issuing commands. Temperature thresholds are safety-critical — never dismiss E_TEMP_HIGH without verifying fan operation.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Real-time hashrate (5-second rolling average). A value of 0 means the miner is offline, booting, or experiencing a catastrophic hashboard failure.

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: 24-hour average hashrate. Sudden drops vs real-time may indicate thermal throttling or a failing hashboard.

telemetry.name: power_draw
telemetry.description: Current PSU power draw. If dramatically lower than the configured limit_watts, a hashboard may be dead or the miner is rebooting.

telemetry.name: temperature_in
telemetry.description: Ambient air temperature entering the miner chassis. High ambient (>40C) compounds outlet thermal risk.

telemetry.name: temperature_out
telemetry.description: Outlet air temperature. CRITICAL metric. Above 85C intervention is required immediately. Above 90C indicates imminent hardware damage.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_in
telemetry.description: Inlet fan speed. Below 2000 RPM indicates a broken fan bearing. A reading of 0 is a total mechanical failure requiring physical inspection.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_out
telemetry.description: Outlet fan speed. Below 2000 RPM indicates a broken fan bearing. A reading of 0 is a total mechanical failure requiring physical inspection.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Safely restarts the controller firmware. The miner will show zero hashrate for 2-3 minutes during boot. Telemetry resumes once fully initialized.
commands.constraints: Do not issue more than once within a 15-minute window. Never reboot while temperature_out > 92C — physically inspect cooling first. Allow 3 minutes after reboot before re-querying hashrate.

commands.name: setPowerLimit
commands.description: Adjusts the PSU output cap. Lowering power reduces hashrate and outlet temperature proportionally. Use during thermal events or high electricity cost periods.
commands.constraints: Never set below 2000W — hashboards will fail to initialize. Maximum depends on model: M30S 3400W, M50S 3500W, M56S 3600W, M60S 4000W. Always verify temperature_out drops within 60 seconds after applying.

examples.intent: Reduce outlet temperature on overheating miner

commands.name: setPools
commands.description: Updates the primary stratum mining pool URL and credentials. Changing pools causes a brief hashrate interruption (~30 seconds) while reconnecting.

troubleshooting: alert.overheat: Verify fan_speed_in/out. If both fans are >4000 RPM and temp is still rising, the airflow path may be blocked. Reduce power via setPowerLimit(2800W) first.
alert.fan_failure: A fan speed of 0 is a mechanical failure. Do not run the miner. Issue no commands — escalate to a human operator for physical inspection.
alert.hashrate_low: Hashboards may be tuning after a power or environment change. Wait 15 minutes before escalating. If hashrate stays <50% of nominal, reboot once.
OFFLINE: Do not issue reboot — the telemetry layer cannot reach the device. Escalate to human operator for physical inspection.

errors.E_TEMP_HIGH: Chip temperature exceeded safe thresholds — thermal intervention required
errors.E_FAN_FAIL: Fan RPM below required threshold — mechanical inspection needed
errors.E_PSU_ERR: PSU reporting error or unstable output — do not issue commands
